**The paper doesn't report an AlpacaEval 2 win rate.** AlpacaEval isn't mentioned anywhere in it.

I can't give page numbers because this HTML version has no page markers, so I've cited sections instead.

All the win rates in the paper are judged by GPT-4 (`gpt-4-0314`) on three tasks:

- **TL;DR summarization** (Section 6.2): DPO wins about 61% against reference summaries at temperature 0.0. PPO's best is about 57%, also at temperature 0.0.
- **Human evaluation on TL;DR** (Sections 6.2 and 6.4, Table 2): humans preferred DPO samples at temperature 0.25 over PPO samples at temperature 0 58% of the time.
- **Out-of-distribution CNN/DailyMail** (Section 6.3, Table 1): against ground-truth summaries, DPO scores 0.36 at temperature 0 and 0.31 at 0.25. PPO scores 0.26 and 0.23.
- **Anthropic-HH single-turn dialogue** (Section 6.2, Figure 3): the paper says DPO is the only computationally efficient method that beats the preferred completions. It doesn't state an exact number; the values are only shown in the figure.

If you need an AlpacaEval 2 result for DPO, it will be in a different source.
